documents.title: MemoryCo delays one equipment delivery
documents.raw_text: MemoryCo delayed one equipment delivery while maintaining annual capacity guidance.
documents.event_summary: A delivery is delayed without a guide change.

facts.statement: MemoryCo delayed one equipment delivery and maintained annual capacity guidance.

analysis.thesis_impact: Initially appears to strengthen supply discipline.
analysis.next_validation: Check annual capacity guidance next quarter.

red_team.alternative_explanation: A logistics delay with unchanged annual guidance is timing, not discipline.
red_team.confirmation_bias: A bullish memory view may overread a single delivery.
red_team.market_knowledge: The company disclosed unchanged annual guidance.
red_team.cannot_prove: It cannot prove annual effective capacity is lower.
red_team.next_validation: Observe actual equipment installation and annual bit-supply guidance.
red_team.worst_position_risk: The equipment arrives later and capacity is unaffected.
